title: Assemble the hosted API
responsibility: Create authentication and optional relay services and a connector for GitHub-backed collaboration.

inputs.name: hubRuntime.env
inputs.description: Hub environment whose fields are all optional: DB, when present, backs the D1 auth store (otherwise the store is null), and CACHE is passed to hubCache. The HARNESS_COLLABORATION_* settings are read only when connect() runs, and a missing or empty owner or repo, or a repository or installation id that is missing, empty, zero or non-numeric, makes connect() throw collaboration-disabled.

outputs.name: hubRuntime
outputs.description: Runtime with auth (the actor and handle members of HubAuth), remote (null or absent when the relay binding or its origin is not configured), connect(), and an optional agent that hubRuntime never sets. Each connect() call creates new collaboration and projection services for the configured repository, with the fixed ref refs/heads/harness-collaboration and path collaboration.json, authenticated by auth-provided tokens, and throws collaboration-disabled when a repository setting is missing or invalid.

errors.name: collaboration-disabled
errors.description: Error thrown by connect() through hubFail, whose code property is 'collaboration-disabled' and message is 'Harness artifact unavailable'. It is thrown before any collaboration or projection service is created, when HARNESS_COLLABORATION_REPOSITORY_ID or HARNESS_COLLABORATION_INSTALLATION_ID is missing, empty, zero or non-numeric, or when HARNESS_COLLABORATION_OWNER or HARNESS_COLLABORATION_REPO is missing or empty.
